  4. Reward the dog with treats and praise when they successfully stay in position.

  1. Start by throwing a ball or toy a short distance away from the dog and encouraging them to retrieve it.

When your dog does something good, like sitting or staying, give them a treat or praise them. This will help them understand what you want them to do. Remember, positive reinforcement is the key to successful dog training!

The more you practice, the better your dog will get. Start with simple commands like "sit," "stay," and "come." Gradually add more complex tricks and commands as your dog becomes more confident.

Training a dog takes time and patience. Don't get frustrated if your dog doesn't learn something right away. Keep practicing, and eventually, they'll get it!
